typography.fonts_import_instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts. Apply 'font-outfit' to headings and 'font-ibm' to body.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise/grain overlay class over the main backgrounds to prevent color banding and add a premium grittiness.

layouts.marketing_hero: Asymmetrical layout with overlapping neon floating status cards against a deep dark background.
layouts.dashboard_ucp: High-density CSS Grid for player stat cards (Character, Licenses, Property, Vehicles). Minimal gaps (gap-6) and rigorous alignment.
layouts.rules_lore: Sidebar navigation (sticky) + wide content area with clear typography, generous spacing (p-8 to p-12).

modules.name: 1. Live Server Status & Stats
modules.components: Hero section, Stats Grid, Connect Button, Copy IP Button, Toast Notification
modules.instructions: Use neon glowing borders for the Connect (fivem://connect) button. Toast MUST use Sonner. Overlay floating glassmorphic stats showing '48/128 Players'.

modules.name: 2. Interactive Web Map
modules.components: Leaflet.js Map Container, Custom Map Blips
modules.instructions: Map must use dark tiles (e.g. CartoDB Dark Matter) or a custom GTA map tile set if available. Add clickable neon blips for Police Stations (cyan), Safe Zones (green), Player Businesses (purple).

modules.name: 3. Player UCP (User Control Panel)
modules.components: Discord OAuth Login State, Player Dashboard Grid, Stat Cards
modules.instructions: Initial state: Discord Login landing using neon purple accents. Logged-in state: Grid cards for Character Registry, Licenses, Property Ledger, and Garage Registry. Use glassmorphic cards for all panels.

modules.name: 4. Donation & Store Hub
modules.components: Pricing Grid, Tier Cards (Bronze VIP, Custom Car, Gang Whitelist)
modules.instructions: 3-column pricing grid. Middle tier MUST use a prominent glowing neon gradient border (Tracing Beam effect) to stand out. Include features checklists and prominent CTA buttons.

modules.name: 5. Server Rules & Lore Hub
modules.instructions: Use Shadcn Accordion for rules (RDM, VDM, Metagaming). Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between Server Rules and City Lore. Sidebar should be sticky on desktop.

image_urls.description: Futuristic cyberpunk city at night with neon lights - perfect for the GTA V server hero background. Apply a heavy bg-black/50 to bg-black/70 overlay to let neon accents pop.
Black sports car at night - ideal for the Player UCP vehicle registry card background or Custom Import Car slot in the store.
Vibrant urban alley illuminated by neon signs - provides a gritty, premium underground vibe for the server store.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with glowing hover states. Avoid standard flat buttons. Use neon gradients where primary action is required.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a sharp, modern gaming/tech look.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='connect-server-btn', data-testid='copy-ip-btn').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text over glassmorphism has minimum 4.5:1 contrast. NEVER use a fully transparent background behind text overlays.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.motion: Implement Framer Motion for staggered card entrances and smooth hover micro-interactions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark mode and neon accent aesthetic (slate-900/zinc-950 base, #00f2fe/#4facfe neon glows).
Build out the 5 core modules as stated: Live Status Hero, Leaflet Interactive Map, Player UCP, Donation Store, Rules & Lore.
Use standard JavaScript files (.js, .jsx) for React components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx) as specified by environment rules.
Use Shadcn UI for standard components but heavily customize their Tailwind classes to match the dark glassmorphic neon aesthetic.
For the Leaflet map, integrate 'react-leaflet' and configure it with a dark theme tile provider (like CartoDB Dark Matter).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use bold, asymmetrical, or dense grid layouts where appropriate.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties like 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform'.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
